verdict.rationale: Only a single generic mention that Recurly RevRec offers 'multi-currency support' for revenue recognition; there is no documentation of per-currency price points on plans, multi-currency billing setup, or consolidated reporting back into a home currency. missing for 10: per-currency price-point configuration on plans/subscriptions, multi-currency invoicing details, consolidated/home-currency reporting mechanics, and independent corroboration beyond one docs line.
